page.head: ILLVSTRISSIMO PRINCIPI AC DOMINO, D. AVGVSTO, Duci Saxoniae, Landgravio Turingiae, & Marchioni Mysiae &c. Domino suo clementissimo.
page.p: [D]ULCISSIMA narratio est in Argonautico carmine ubi heroum exercitus fugiens Colchicam classem, deliberat quo dirigat cursu, ut sequuturos hostes fallat. Ibi narrat quispiam velut erudition, non recta via ad Hellespontum accedendum esse qua antea venerant, sed longe supra ostium esse Istri, ad quod navigare tutum sit & alibi ex Istro viam esse ad mare Adriaticum. Ait se totius terrae situm & metas, Oceani ambitum, spacia maris infusi in terram, fluminum fontes & cursus,
page.notes: The large woodcut initial D is a decorative historiated letter showing figures. The initial is joined to the word "ULCISSIMA" as printed ("VLCISSIMA"). Lower-page watermark text "http://rcin.org.pl" is a digitiser's link and is omitted. Some words are printed with uncertain letters (e.g. "erudition" for erudite, "Ioli" forms) and may be printing errors; they are copied as printed.
